scheme_name: PM SHRI Schools (PM Schools for Rising India)
overview: PM SHRI Schools (PM Schools for Rising India) is a centrally sponsored scheme by the Government of India aimed at developing more than 14,500 schools managed by Central Government, State/UT Governments, local bodies, KVS, and NVS. The initiative seeks to provide a safe, stimulating, and inclusive learning environment with quality infrastructure and resources, aligned with the National Education Policy 2020. It targets over 20 lakh students as direct beneficiaries and aims to scale up learnings to other schools nationwide. The scheme is implemented over a five-year period from 2022-23 to 2026-27.
objectives: Develop more than 14,500 PM SHRI Schools across India
Ensure every student feels welcomed and cared for in a safe and stimulating learning environment
Provide wide-ranging learning experiences and good physical infrastructure conducive to learning
Nurture students to become engaged, productive, and contributing citizens for an equitable, inclusive, and plural society
Promote understanding of various dimensions of quality in school education to inform policy, practice, and implementation
Scale up learnings from PM SHRI Schools to other schools in the country
Showcase implementation of the National Education Policy 2020 and emerge as exemplar schools
eligibility: Schools managed by Central Government, State/UT Government, local bodies including Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan (KVS) and Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti (NVS) are eligible to be developed under the PM SHRI Schools scheme.
benefits: Students benefit from a safe and stimulating learning environment, wide range of learning experiences, good physical infrastructure, and appropriate resources conducive to learning. The scheme aims to nurture students to become engaged, productive, and contributing citizens for building an equitable, inclusive, and plural society as envisaged by the National Education Policy 2020. It also promotes understanding of various dimensions of quality in school education to inform policy, practice, and implementation, with learnings scaled up to other schools.
financial_support: As a centrally sponsored scheme, financial support is provided by the Government of India for the development and upgradation of PM SHRI Schools, though specific quantum, type, and mechanism details are not explicitly stated in the evidence.
application_process: The application process is not detailed in the provided evidence. Information regarding application steps for schools to join the PM SHRI Schools scheme is not available on the reviewed pages.
implementing_agency: Ministry of Education, Department of School Education & Literacy
